tools.name: verify_links
tools.description: Check up to 10 URLs before citing or sending them. Per URL: verdict (live, live_but_text_not_found, soft_404, parked, dead, blocked_or_rate_limited, unreachable), HTTP status, final URL, title, and optional check that an expected phrase appears. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: verify_citations
tools.description: Verify up to 10 citations really exist and match the claimed title/authors/year, against Crossref, DataCite, arXiv and PubMed. Items: DOI, arXiv id, 'PMID: 123', free-text reference, or {doi|arxiv|pmid|title, authors, year}. Verdicts: verified, mismatch, not_found, error. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (

tools.name: find_archive
tools.description: For up to 10 URLs (e.g. dead links), find the closest Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot, optionally nearest a date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Returns snapshot URL, capture time, captured status. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).
